svg.title: PrefetchTrainPipelineSparseDist: one steady-state progress()
svg.desc: Host submission order, not a measured timeline. Backend cache dependencies still apply. Solid bars: logical execution/access scopes; hollow dashed bars: unconsumed requests. Blue H2D, red D2H/host sync, purple AllToAll, amber request wait, green stream dependency. Entry: i has post-prefetch state; i+1 has an outstanding split request. Training stream joins prefetch(i); zero_grad already submitted enqueue_batch(i+2): nonblocking device copy wait_sparse_data_dist(i+1): host reads splits; launch payload Read receive sizes onto the host (D2H + stream synchronization), allocate buffers, then launch lengths and ID values AllToAll. Forward of batch i; payload of i+1 can overlap PrefetchPipelinedForward consumes ready input / context for i Lookup(i), output AllToAll(i), downstream forward(i) Composite compute stage including an embedding collective; the whole bar is not NCCL execution time. Clear consumed post-prefetch dictionaries for i After forward returns; before backward is submitted _prefetch(i+1): second wait / reconstruct KJT on data_dist Consumes payload and reconstructs the KJT; uncached, nonempty CUDA lengths in the fixed-stride path require D2H and current-stream synchronization. Prefetch stream waits for data_dist; record_stream module.prefetch(i+1); save ready input + context backward(i), reverse embedding AllToAll(i), optimizer(i) Composite compute stage including an embedding collective; the whole bar is not NCCL execution time. Source allows concurrent submission; actual prefetch/backward overlap is backend-dependent. Prepare the following iteration data_dist waits for the copy of i+2 start_sparse_data_dist(i+2): launch split AllToAll Submit split-size AllToAll; compatible metadata requests may be fused by process group. dequeue i; next forward will join prefetch(i+1)
